COMPLICATIONS OF STROKE
- Short term: tentorial herniation with coning and death; cardiac arrhythmias,
hyperglycaemia, aspiration pneumonitis with sepsis, urinary tract
infections; deep vein thrombosis
- Long term: decubitus ulcers, depression, epilepsy, dementia, parkinsonism, contractures, thalamic pain
Investigations
- Neuro-imaging with CT scan/MRI to determine stroke type and choice of
management
- Lumbar puncture for CSF analysis in suspected subarachnoid haemorrhage
- Electrocardiography, echocardiography, carotid Doppler ultrasound study,
cerebral angiography
- Full Blood Count with differentials, random blood glucose, urea,
electrolytes and creatinine
- Chest radiograph, HIV screening
